text: The screening agent reads the deviation estate of a case on GET /api/recovery/deviation/v1/deviations with caseId as the query, and a case this service holds no open deviation for is answered with an empty list and 200 rather than a 404.
why: The Ownership Map gives S8 two write operations (POST /cases/{caseId}/deviations and PATCH /deviations/{deviationId}) and no read, while legacy RWB-E1-062 reads deviation.deviation_code so a code already open is not proposed again and rwb-agent's contract of this legacy key names this read as its source for the open codes; no source publishes a read of the estate, and the case row is rwb-case's, so this service cannot confirm its existence.
read: Context pack S8 ownership rows (REST operations provided: 2); legacy RWB-E1-062 section 11 (DF-CAS-038, DF-CAS-019); TSD S8 T3.1, T-A.1; Template and Rules v1 R4 and R9
confirm: Solution architect and the rwb-deviation owner, before the contract is tagged
impact: One read operation is published on the service base; if the Ownership Map is not amended, the operation has no catalogue row and the gap is reported at wave 1 exit

text: The gate reads the autonomy mode of policy SCREENING at its version in force on the rwb-agent contract RWB-P10-E1062-CON, refuses a raise that names raised_by SCREENING_AGENT with 409 and no user message while the mode is SHADOW, and writes nothing; deviation_open, the contact stop and both clocks stay with rwb-case and with the raise step and are never written by this slice.
why: agent_policy.autonomy_mode is a rwb_agent column (legacy BR1, DF-AGT-008) and no operation of S8 publishes the mode, so it is read on the owner's contract; no source gives a message id for a refusal no person sees, and the case flag and the clocks belong to P3 and to the raise step of this service.

impact: In shadow a screening raise cannot reach a deviation row; an agent-policy outage refuses the raise instead of falling back to raising

text: The maximum number of deviations one answer carries is a parameter value read through the parameters contract and client library of rwb-case (DP-06); its value is not published and the story reads it, never writes it in code.
why: The read answers the whole open estate of a case and no source publishes a page size or a cap for it; the parameter contract is the only place a business person may change such a value, and R7.3 forbids inventing one.

confirm: Business lead and the rwb-case parameter owner, before wave 1 exit
impact: A cap is resolved at run time; until DL sets a value the parameter is absent and the read answers the whole estate of the case
